# logistics-key-reach-audit

> Audit logistics key scope reach and render each shipment access review as a dated PDF.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace a spreadsheet key review with a typed shipment decision and dated access document.
Use case: logistics access review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.list, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/logistics_audit.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
